ideas.why: Accurate for a 3-URL sitemap, but lastmod has minor effect and applies to almost any site.
The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it reverses that.

ideas.idea: Add address, days and hours to the visit page, with LocalBusiness openingHours markup
ideas.why: The visit page description promises opening times and directions, but the page has only one sentence and no address or directions.

ideas.idea: List all varieties and add a page per variety
ideas.why: The page claims over forty varieties but names only two, and per-variety pages would give each one its own address and content.

ideas.idea: Add links from the home page intro to varieties and visit
ideas.why: The nav already links to both pages, so in-body links add little.

ideas.idea: Add a default title and description in the layout metadata
ideas.why: All current pages set their own, so this only guards against pages added later.

ideas.idea: Add a description to the account page
ideas.why: The page is deliberately noindexed, and the report itself calls this optional.

ideas.idea: Add city or region to the page titles, such as the visit page
ideas.why: The visit title 'Visit the orchard' doesn't name the business or place, while the home page text mentions Herefordshire.
